newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi seizes 52,000 jars of fake Vaseline.
newsitem.headline: Saudi seizes 52,000 jars of fake Vaseline.

text.p: Saudi Arabia seized 52,000 jars of fake Vaseline, a brand made by the Anglo-Dutch conglomerate Unilever Plc, in a Commerce Department sting operation, the daily Arab News reported on Sunday.
"The large quantity of imitation Vaseline...was seized from a warehouse after it was put under surveillance and then inspected by a special task force," the paper said.
It said the jars were manufactured in an unnamed Arab state, adding that the law firm representing the Unilever agent in the kingdom said the company did not produce the seized lubricant.
The English-language Arab News said Unilever lodged several complaints last year against local dealers selling imitation products.
